speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Alcohol-induced liver cirrhosis with hepatocellular carcinoma.

Your history of heavy alcohol consumption (5 drinks daily) combined with your age and symptoms of jaundice, weight loss, and fatigue is highly suggestive of advanced liver disease. The unexplained weight loss is particularly concerning for a malignant process such as hepatocellular carcinoma arising on a background of cirrhosis. Given this high probability, I am requesting images of your Liver and Abdomen to visualize the extent of the damage and check for any masses.
